A Moral Voyage: The Search for a Study Spot

Published on Jan 31, 2016
  • Commonwealth Honors College

From Honors Student Blog:

I feel like this thesis makes me write like I’m running out of time! But I’ve noticed one thing – I cannot write my thesis at the desk in my room. It’s impossible! I get distracted by the TV in my common room, the food in my kitchen, or the messiness of my side of the bedroom – everything in the world except my actual thesis. So, earlier this week, I set off in search of the perfect study spot on campus.
